joins: each Invoice to its InvoiceLine, on InvoiceId (declared key)
each InvoiceLine to its Track, on TrackId (declared key)
each Track to its Album, on AlbumId (declared key)
each Album to its Artist, on ArtistId (declared key)
measures: customer count: number of different Invoice customer id
planner_note: Count distinct customers on invoices with an AC/DC track.
text: Shows customer count. Reads Invoice, InvoiceLine, Track, Album and Artist, where Artist name is 'AC/DC'.
